types.label: Fires
types.blurb: Fires in the 2026 war: every fire at a town on a day an Israeli military attack is documented there (white phosphorus, incendiary munitions, illumination flares, or a fire lit by an explosion), and every fire in the yellow-line zone or round Beaufort Castle, whatever lit it. Each fire is measured from satellites (NASA FIRMS, Sentinel-2, Copernicus EFFIS) and from the reports of the same day.

types.label: White Phosphorus
types.blurb: White phosphorus munitions fired over South Lebanon, each attack built from the reports, footage and satellite detections of its day. A geolocated attack was placed on the ground; one not geolocated is shown at its village.

types.label: Forced Displacement Orders
types.blurb: Evacuation and displacement orders issued over South Lebanon: who was told to leave, by what means the order reached them, and whether an attack followed.
